messages:
zoe: spontaneous couch co-op tonight? thinking 7pm in the lounge, bring controllers and low-drama games.
harry: down. ill bring my wired xbox and a bag of AA batteries just in case.
mina: can someone bring a multi-outlet? only one bench plug near the couch.
carlos: I have a 2m extension + 4-socket surge. labeled.
alan: i'll DJ chill tunes and bring sugar-free drinks. please bring cups if you care about leaks. :headphones: :cup_with_straw:
katie: small poll: chaotic Smash or cooperative puzzle night? react :one: for Smash :two: for co-op.
zoe: also, tiny PSA for folks using Steam Remote Play over corp wifi: set streaming to "fast" or bring a LAN cable.
harry: quick helper if someone's controller isn't recognized on mac:
```
# mac troubleshooting
system_profiler SPUSBDataType | grep -i xbox -A5
```

mina: i'll bring sanitizing wipes for controllers and a small towel.
setup-bot: calendar: "Couch Co-op + Joysticks" created by zoe for Tonight 7:00 PM - 10:00 PM. Location: Lounge.
zoe: perfect. see you all at 7. if you're bringing guests DM me so we don't go over capacity. :sparkles:
